DHM Sendsch.37. 59 ; Assyrian libittu; Arabic , , , , (loan-words according to Frä 4f. ); according to Thes and most from whiteness of clay, or light colour of sun-baked bricks; so Nö ZMG xi,1886, 735 Lag BN 139 ; > others regard as Assyrian loan-word VOJ i. 22ff. ; in Assyrian a derivative from labânu , throw down, prostrate , is sought Dl Pr. 93f.(compare HWB 369) ); — ׳ל Gen 11:3 ; Ezek 4:1 ; construct לִבְנַת Exod 24:10 ; plural לְבֵנִים Gen 11:3 7 t.; suffix מִלִּבְנֵיכֶם Exod 5:19 ; — 1 brick, as building-material , Gen 11:3 (singular collective; elsewhere plural) 11:3 ; Exod 1:14 ; straw used in making 5:7 , compare 5:8 ; 5:16 ; 5:18 ; 5:19 ; Isa 9:9 (figurative; as inferior to גָּזִית hewn stone ); incense burnt on 65:3 ( = roof-tiles ? compare Che Di). 2 = tile , on which plan of city could be engraved ( חקק ) Ezek 4:1 . 3 = pavement , Exod 24:10 (compare Di).
